status: WIP measured increment; six positive paired throughput observations, not general workload acceptance

source_change.go_source: client-go internal/client/conn_batch.go getClientAndSend publishes from the batch send loop; stream receive work remains separate
source_change.rust_root: submit -> flush -> send_group -> recreate_stream had async wrappers but no asynchronous leaf. Publication and retirement entered Runtime::block_on unnecessarily. ChannelPool::get_or_create already owns the runtime context required for connect_lazy.
source_change.change: Make the full publication/recreation chain synchronous; pass the runtime explicitly to open_stream and use runtime.spawn for I/O. Remove production block_on calls at publication and retirement. Keep per-caller validation, receipts, cancellation, forwarding, generation ownership and source batching policy unchanged.

collector_diagnosis.interpretation: No millisecond-scale average deadline overshoot. Rust probe covers only waiting batches, with first/last partial reporting windows omitted. Go mean covers all batches and subtracts wait-head from wait-more; counts match. Do not equate these populations or infer per-request latency directly. An armed batch flushed by a lifecycle barrier is also in the probe's deadline category.
collector_diagnosis.cleanup: Temporary timing fields and probe removed with apply_patch; cmp against batching-before.rs confirms byte-identical restoration. Probe binary, source diff and raw logs retained.

measurement.method: Corrected sysbench 1.0.20; same 100000-row owned TiKV fixture; prepared oltp_read_only; 6000/30000/30000 fixed transactions at 1/8/32 clients, 1000 warmup events per trial, before/after/after/before order; explicit percentile 95; process CPU and TiKV histogram counter deltas. No instrumented timing probe in either measured binary.
measurement.parity: Six result sets match Go, the immediate control, the new candidate and the retained drain-only control before and after: 307 lines, SHA256 ad1e46405a9ace48963d51a9608eb036609ada257d87fffd4943b3b79a144a4c. All timed trials report zero errors and reconnects.
measurement.limitations: Two samples per binary per concurrency; modest effects, host variation remains possible. The eight-client p95 is unchanged and SQL CPU rises 0.25 percent. This does not erase the prior adaptive-collector regression against drain-only Rust. Go binary revision differs from checkout HEAD; no complete package, metadata or TPC-C parity claim.

validation.results: 10 unit, 75 batch, 2 concurrency, 1 cancellation, 2 unary checks passed, with one overlap: 89 distinct checks. Release server build passed. Logs are *-sync.log under the collector-timing artifact directory. No Ready lint run.

remaining: The generic throughput-and-latency goal remains open: adaptive collection still has an eight-client regression against the drain-only control, broader prepared-plan reuse remains incomplete, and TPC-C has not been validated in this increment.
